mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% indicates sustained monetary accommodation, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 8.0% signals economic weakness triggering monetary easing expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0%, 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 12-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 12mo_MA, 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) from prior month signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days during industrial slowdown regimes.
failure_condition: When INDPRO declines from prior month, 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) above 135,000 thousand indicates strong labor market supporting consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between PAYEMS and 60-day forward returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1,000.0 thousand units signals housing market strength boosting consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1000.0, 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 135,000) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 7.5%) indicates tight labor market supporting economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 7.5%, 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) from prior month signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during tightening regimes.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises from prior month, 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
